title: Firelight Reel

arranging: A stomp-along tavern reel for a room that dances. The kick lands on every beat once the band is in, the string bass thumps on the beat and walks into each chord change, the snare cracks on two and four. The fiddle drives the intro and breaks as written and answers the singer with short runs between lines; on the last chorus it doubles the tune an octave up. Energy peaks at the last chorus; nothing drops to quiet. Keep the singer on top, but let the band push: little ducking.
